canonical_name: No System and Communications Protection Policy
description: System and communications protection policy and procedures are not developed, documented, and maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing system and communications protection policy documentation, outdated procedures, lack of policy dissemination evidence, absence of defined roles and responsibilities for system and communications protection, and no coordination mechanisms across organizational entities.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - System and Communications Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
